comment: Props balance (PROPS_LAYERS.md section 1 / 3). The C++ hardcodes nothing. Every number has a '<key>_comment' next to it. Values marked PLACEHOLDER are not named by the design or the designer yet: tune them here.

barrel.shape_comment: Designer 2026-11-10 #1: barrels are cylinders in the greybox.
barrel.radius_cm_comment: From the layout's barrel covers (60 x 60 footprint).

barrel_explosive.shape_comment: Same look as a barrel, red band in the greybox.
barrel_explosive.explosion_radius_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Kept below explosive.min_gap_cm (400) so only a cluster chains.

turret_mg.radius_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Footprint half size for the placement gaps (C4).

mine.marker_visible_cm_comment: Designer 2026-11-10 #4: a visible marker within 3 m.
mine.shot_detonates_comment: Designer #4: a shot detonates the mine. Disarming is task C7b (its numbers come with it).

loot_pile.radius_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Footprint half size of a loose loot pile for the placement gaps (C4).

crate_colors.dangerous_comment: Designer #1: red = a dangerous crate (mined / explosive). The colour tells the player what is safe to open. Derived from the data (a mines-layer object attached to the crate), not drawn separately: the share of mined crates is mines_default.crates.percent.

layout_view.comment: Doorway rules of the layout view (PROPS_LAYERS.md 2.1, read by FPropsLayoutView::ReadConfig; the C++ defaults equal these values).
layout_view.gate_min_gap_cm_comment: Narrowest gap between collinear fence / wall segments that counts as a gate.
layout_view.gate_max_gap_cm_comment: Designer 2026-11-10: fence gaps up to 600 cm are gates (the tractor yard F_tanks_N / F_tanks_S 500 cm gaps). Building doors and the cut's gaps are not affected.
layout_view.door_through_slack_cm_comment: Designer 2026-11-10: a doorway is on the mandatory route only when the route passes THROUGH it (crosses its wall line within half the opening + this slack) or turns around at it. Passing by is not enough.
layout_view.door_turn_reach_cm_comment: 'Turns at it' = a route vertex where the route reverses or ends, at most this far in front of the doorway on its outward side (R_main turns 180 cm in front of the shed door).
layout_view.door_fallback_width_cm_comment: Opening width of a building door that has no matching wall gap.
layout_view.tall_cover_min_cm_comment: Turret sightlines (C4): covers at least this tall block a standing man's view on the ground (the evaluator's rule, evaluate.ts).
layout_view.eye_height_cm_comment: Turret sightlines: the eye above the surface; on a roof only walls / covers reaching roof level + this block (the evaluator's elevated rule).
layout_view.roof_edge_inset_cm_comment: Anchor 'roof_edges' (2.1): the lattice ring this far inside a walkable roof's footprint edge.

exclude.spawn_cm_comment: Keep-out radius around spawn (section 1.3 crates example).
exclude.route_cm_comment: Corridor half-width on the mandatory route / on variants.
exclude.hole_rim_cm_comment: Beyond the roof / floor hole rim.

crates_default.count_comment: per_100m2 = crates per 100 m2 of eligible area; max = cap for this layer.
crates_default.min_spacing_cm_comment: Between crates; also the keep-out radius of a deleted crate.
crates_default.min_gap_any_cm_comment: To objects of every other layer.
crates_default.wall_gap_cm_comment: Gap to walls / footprints / covers (the designer 2026-11-10: crates stand right against walls, along them); doorways stay clear through exclude.door_cm 250.
crates_default.exclude_comment: The standard keep-out set below; a layer's rules.exclude overrides it key by key.

barrels_default.count_comment: Barrels per map. Designer 2026-11-10: ALL barrels are explosive and there must be few of them (was 30 with 30 % explosive clusters).
barrels_default.cluster_comment: Members per cluster and the ring offset range (cm).
barrels_default.explosive_comment: share of clusters that are explosive (designer 2026-11-10: every barrel is explosive -> 1.0); min_gap_cm 400 = designer #5; no explosive within 25 m of spawn.
barrels_default.min_gap_any_cm_comment: To objects of every other layer.

turrets_default.cover_route_comment: Range window (cm), firing arc (deg), minimum metres of the route covered (route = the first mandatory one unless 'route' names one). behind_cover_gap_cm: a behind_tall_cover anchor stands this far off the cover's side (PLACEHOLDER).
turrets_default.where_comment: Turrets stand only at anchors (2.3): ambush points, roof edges, the far side of covers >= 140 cm.
turrets_default.min_gap_any_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. To objects of every other layer.
turrets_default.wall_gap_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. To walls / parapets / covers (a roof-edge anchor is 100 cm inside the parapet).
turrets_default.exclude_comment: The standard keep-outs; no turret within 40 m of the spawn (section 1.3 example).

mines_default.doorways_comment: ceil(25 % x eligible doors), 80 cm inside; mandatory-route doors forbidden unless 'mandatory_route': 'allow' (designer #3). mode count = 'value' doors.
mines_default.crates_comment: ceil(10 % x the source layer's UNLOCKED crates) carry a trap; a mined crate is red (crate_colors.dangerous).
mines_default.field_comment: Free-standing mines in the cut (section 1.3 example); kept off ladders, stairs and the mandatory route corridor, allowed on variants.
mines_default.min_spacing_cm_comment: Keep-out radius of a deleted mine (any sub-rule).
mines_default.exclude_comment: Doorway mines: no doorway mine this close to the spawn / end.

loot_default.tables_comment: Loot tables the layer draws from (loot_tables below). Ground piles and crates draw from these minus roof_table.
loot_default.budget_value_comment: Total loot value of the map (table values below).
loot_default.containers_comment: round(crates_share x the unlocked, not mined (blue) crates) hold loot; together they spend at most budget_share x budget_value (PLACEHOLDER), the rest buys loose piles.
loot_default.loose_comment: Loose piles at the anchors, weighted by the distance to the mandatory route (weights: nearer than the band / inside it / beyond it; PLACEHOLDER); roof piles use roof_table (a reward for climbing).
loot_default.min_spacing_cm_comment: Between loose piles (and from a loose pile to a filled crate).
loot_default.min_gap_any_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. A loose pile to objects of every other layer.
loot_default.wall_gap_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. A loose pile to walls / covers.
loot_default.exclude_comment: The standard keep-outs for loose piles.

ammo_common.value_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Budget cost of one roll.

budgets.spawn_ms_warn_comment: WARN when spawning on Depot takes longer (ms).
budgets.nav_agent_radius_cm_comment: Obstacles are widened by this in the nav gate (section 2.4).

greybox.comment: G003 (2026-11-17): the runtime look of a levelgen prop while class_map has no real class for it (PropsGreybox, ACodexPropActor::ApplyGreybox). Shapes and sizes come from 'kinds' above; the keys here only add what 'kinds' does not say. Colours are linear RGB 0..1. Used for Training Ground autogen props files (source auto); Codex.Props.Greybox 2 applies it to every props file, 0 turns it off.

colors.barrel_comment: PLACEHOLDER. A plain barrel (none are generated since every barrel is explosive).
colors.mine_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Bright red marker (designer 6.1 #4: a visible marker).
colors.default_comment: Any variant with no colour of its own.

turret_mg.height_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Height of the turret body (a cylinder of kinds.turret_mg.radius_cm).
turret_mg.muzzle_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Gun bar on top, along the turret's yaw (the centre of its arc).

mine.size_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. The marker disc on the ground.
mine.wire_height_cm_comment: PLACEHOLDER. A tripwire's wire across the doorway (its width_cm) this high.

gameplay.comment: G003b (2026-11-17): on a live map (PIE / game) the props spawn as the game's REAL objects (PropsGameplayRules, UCodexLevelPropsSubsystem): class key -> native class path. Class keys: the variant, except a crate holding a loot table or a crate-mine = 'crate_container', a mines object by its trigger = 'mine_tripwire' / 'mine_proximity'. A key with no entry (plain crates: no gameplay crate class exists, they are cover) keeps the greybox ACodexProp* actor. Each actor keeps its own tuning (damage, radii, timings); only the numbers below are set by the props pipeline. Codex.Props.Real 0 = greybox only.

classes.barrel_comment: Fuel barrel: a shot / a blast / a trap explodes it (fire blast), a match lights it.
classes.crate_container_comment: A crate with loot (blue, opened by clicking) or a mined crate (red: the crate's tripwire charge, defuse first).
classes.turret_mg_comment: The game's automated turret: fires at the nearest enemy (the squad's side), can be repaired / picked up.
classes.mine_proximity_comment: Level mine: hidden under the snow until an operative comes within reveal_cm, blows up on contact.
classes.mine_tripwire_comment: Hostile PMC wire across the doorway (the object's width_cm), armed at level start, hidden until spotted.
classes.loot_pile_comment: A pile of items on the ground (click: the leader walks up and picks up what he can carry).

gameplay.reveal_cm_comment: Designer 2026-11-10 #4: a mine / wire becomes visible when an operative is within 3 m (the mine actor's DetectionRange, the wire's SpotRangeCm; the Medic-Sapper keeps his bonus).
gameplay.spawn_frame_budget_ms_comment: Props spawned per frame until this much time is spent; the rest go on the next frames (the 60 ms budget is per frame).

turrets.comment: Designer 2026-11-17: level turrets on generated maps start INACTIVE (unpowered). A props turret object may state its own "faction" (hostile / neutral / friendly) and "powered" (bool); the rest follow these rules. The power mechanic (generator / fuel) is designed later and hooks into ATurretActor::SetPowered / SetFaction.
turrets.powered_share_comment: Share of a map's turrets that start powered (rounded; chosen by the object id hash). A props file may override it with a top-level "turret_powered_share".
turrets.powered_faction_comment: Side of the turrets powered by the share: they fire at the squad.
turrets.default_faction_comment: Side of the unpowered turrets (inactive until the power mechanic switches them on).

gameplay.traps_faction_comment: Side of the level mines / doorway wires: hostile (default: hidden until spotted, trip on operatives, PMC wire) or squad (the squad's own: visible, trip on everyone).

loot.crate_rolls_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Draws from the crate's loot table (weighted, seeded by the object id).
loot.pile_rolls_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Draws from a pile's table (only entries a pile can hold).
loot.mined_crate_table_comment: PLACEHOLDER. A mined crate's contents (the reward for defusing it).

items.comment: Loot-table item id -> what it puts in a crate (FLootContents field: count) and on a pile (ETransferItem: count). An item with no 'pile' entry is never drawn for a pile.
items.bandage_comment: PLACEHOLDER. The game has no bandage item yet: a medkit.
items.grenade_comment: Grenades are not a ground item (ETransferItem): crates only.

class_map.comment: variant -> soft class path. PLACEHOLDER paths: the real classes arrive with C6; nothing is hardcoded in C++. Keys 'comment' / '*_comment' are not variants.
class_map.loot_crate_comment: No actor: loot inside a crate is the crate actor's loot table (section 3.2).
class_map.mine_crate_comment: No actor: a mined crate = the crate actor + an armed UCodexPropTrapComponent (section 3.2); the mine object exists only in data.
